parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a test-marked record must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor should be applied. `MockNotificationMessage` is a deliberate test double that mirrors the shape of the production protocol `AsyncNotificationMessage` — the near-identical member list (`makeMessage`, `makeNotification`, `name`) is the expected consequence of a mock faithfully replicating its subject's interface, not an accidental duplication. Introducing a shared parent protocol would couple production semantics in `Core` to test infrastructure in `CoreTesting`, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
